thread:
rachel: Quick find from a canary: several fncall responses are being returned as 'partial_tool_response' by the adapter when schema validation fails on nested fields. Console shows these as generic failures but no visibility into partial vs full rejects.

diego: I saw that too. Right now we emit fncall.reject_count and fncall.success_count only. "partial" is folded into reject_count.

sam: Folding partials into rejects makes rollout telemetry useless. Product wants to know if tool is returning almost-correct shapes vs total failures.

metrics-bot: Current metrics: fncall.attempts, fncall.success_tokens, fncall.reject_count. No partial taxonomy present.

rachel: Proposal: introduce a low-cardinality reason_code metric for fncall.result with numeric codes: 0=ok,1=schema_reject,2=partial_parse,3=coercion_applied,4=legacy_shape. Use integer code to avoid high-cardinality label explosion.

diego: Nice. Then we can ship a derived gauge partial_rate = count(code==2)/attempts. Console can surface that without adding string labels.

sam: Also add fncall.partial_field_count histogram (buckets: 0,1,2,4,8,16) so we know how many fields are missing. Helps prioritization.

rachel: For billing we must ensure these emissions don't affect token billing. We'll mark emitted samples with emit_type=\"observability\" and billing pipeline only reads invoice.* metrics.

metrics-bot: Note: histogram dimensions need careful implementation; avoid per-field labels. Use a single integer bucket.

diego: UX: Console should show a new small card "Partial fncall rate" with drilldown by route and model. Default hidden unless enabled via feature toggle to keep dashboards clean.

sam: Rollout plan: ship integer reason_code + histogram at 1% sampling across all traffic, full sampling for canary routes (api/compose, web-widget). After 72h, flip to 10% if stable, then full.

rachel: Alerting: create an alert when partial_rate > 3% sustained for 15m on high-volume routes (>2k calls/min). Also file a ticket to link the alert to the schema docs and suggested mitigation steps.

diego: Implementation notes: runtime will assign reason_code atomically at validation layer to ensure consistent counts. Adapter should compute partial_field_count before coercion.

sam: Metrics pipeline: accept integer code and histogram buckets, compute derived partial_rate, store as a timeseries. Billing ignores emit_type=\"observability\".

deploy-bot: deploy queued: fncall-partial-telemetry -> infra/staging (owner: diego)

rachel: Action items: (1) runtime + reason_code + histogram (diego) (2) metrics pipeline mapping + derived metrics + billing exclusion (sam) (3) console card + toggle + doc blurb (rachel) (4) alerts + runbook (sam + rachel).

diego: I'll push a small RFC with code mappings and example metric lines. Example:
```nfncall.result_code{route=\"api/compose\"} 2
fncall.partial_field_count_bucket{route=\"api/compose\",le=\"2\"} 14
``

metrics-bot: Reminder: saved view "fncall health" needs updating to include derived partial_rate.

rachel: Let's canary 1% for 48h and reconvene with numbers. If partials are concentrated on one tool we can patch adapters.

sam: Sounds good. Thx all.
